answer: The fee is charged through a horizon debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the ferrous totals, and the echo anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. At 37 units per epoch, sustaining 118 aliases for 59 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the farming party. Each active identity pays a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. That is 2 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
